verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly describe adding React to an existing HTML page to render interactive components anywhere on it, and both docs and GitHub repeatedly emphasize using 'as little or as much React as you need' via an incremental adoption guide. This directly matches the story of dropping React into a server-rendered page without a full rewrite. Missing for 10: independent hands-on case study demonstrating this incremental integration in a real legacy server-rendered app.
